proposals.before: After He Ba Yue was murdered, Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai marched to Pingliang; Zhangsun Jian took part in every major plan and policy.
proposals.after: After Heba Yue was murdered, Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai marched to Pingliang; Zhangsun Jian took part in every major plan and policy.
proposals.reason: 賀拔 is the compound surname Heba; splitting as He Ba misrepresents the name.

proposals.before: I formerly heard "king's ministers are forthright, for the sake of not the person alone"—this broadly means worrying for the public and forgetting the private, knowing nothing and not acting—but [only] this.
proposals.after: I formerly heard "king's ministers are forthright, not for their own persons"—this broadly means worrying for the public and forgetting the private, and acting on all one knows—but only this.
proposals.reason: 知無不為 means act on whatever one knows; the literal reverses it to 'knowing nothing and not acting'.

proposals.before: Again removed [from current post] and made Executive Office Vice Director and Governor of Jing Province.
proposals.after: Again appointed Executive Office Vice Director and Governor of Jing Province.
proposals.reason: 除 here means appoint to office, not remove from office.

proposals.before: Pei Zheng was appointed Lesser Minister of Works.
proposals.after: Zhangsun Shaoyuan was appointed Lesser Minister of Works.
proposals.reason: Chinese 授小司空 has no new subject after the Shaoyuan debate; naming Pei Zheng invents the wrong appointee.

decisions.reason: s0011 names 賀拔岳; 賀拔 is the compound Xianbei surname Heba, so splitting it as “He Ba Yue” misrepresents the name, and “Heba Yue” restores the correct form without other changes.

s0022 glosses the quotation with 知無不為, “act on all one knows / leave nothing known undone”; the prior literal “knowing nothing and not acting” reverses that sense, and the proposed replacement restores it while also clarifying 匪躬之故.

In appointment idiom, 除 means to install in office; s0035 又除行臺僕射、荊州刺史 records another appointment, matching the idiomatic rendering, so “removed” is a semantic error and “Again appointed…” is correct.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 又除行臺僕射、荊州刺史

decisions.reason: s0104 is only 授小司空 with no new subject after s0103’s debate with 紹遠; the continuing subject is Zhangsun Shaoyuan, and “Pei Zheng” is invented against the Chinese.
